bullets: Second straight fall, and this time throughput did it.
564 in against 611 resolved, so open went 657 → 588. Last week the backlog only fell because inflow was quiet; this week the closed bar cleared the stack outright.

8–30 days went 247 → 146 while 31–90 went 256 → 267. 277 cases are now past 30 days against 271 a week ago, and the median open ticket is 27 days old.
The 90+ tail is the clean win.
10 against 15 last week and 73 at the start of August. Oldest work is genuinely being cleared.
